result.verdictSummary: FAIL. Stripped to clay, the R108 d upper body reads as an inflated action figure — spherical deltoids, egg upper arms and bulb forearms separated by circumferential creases, on a torso whose chest is a horizontal ledge with no forward depth (the abdomen sits AHEAD of the pec in profile) and whose abdomen is two smooth tubes with no blocks; the R109 lower body's widths match the reference within ~0.02 at every landmark but its outline is a uniform cone with the knee barely suggested. The single biggest reason it does not read as the supreme humanoid is that every primary mass is still a solid of revolution: the deltoid–arm chain shows it most, and no facet, coat or class table can put an insertion where the clay has a cuff.

findings.region: Side view (yaw 90 deg): bust, waist, glute, thigh depth
findings.referenceDoes: Sheet side views (both SIDE VIEW panels) and the hero: the bust is a rounded dome ~0.13 H deep front-to-back at the chest, the waist ~0.06 H deep, the glute projects to ~0.15 H — about 2.4x the waist depth and slightly past the bust — and both masses are convex with no re-entrant corners; the thigh's depth then tapers continuously to the knee. The S-curve is carried by the glute.
findings.implementationDoes: f-02-silhouette-side.png (R108 d): the bust reads as a horizontal beak/shelf at t 0.32-0.36 (central-run depth 0.18-0.196, arm partly merged) whose underside snaps back to 0.124 at t 0.44 — a re-entrant corner; the glute is 0.232 at t 0.54 (1.87x the waist depth, 1.18x the bust), then the same corrugation as the front (0.167 / 0.184 / 0.159 / 0.087 / 0.122 at t 0.60 / 0.64 / 0.68 / 0.72 / 0.78). f-c1b-chest-side-clay.png and f-d7-glute-side.png are the material-level views of the same outline.
findings.whyItFails: A shelf with a sharp underside is the two-ring-lobe bust reading as a ledge — the same ring-wider-than-both-neighbours fault documented for the trapezius — and a silhouette corner reads as hardware, not anatomy. With glute/waist depth at 1.87 against the reference's ~2.4, the profile's S is carried by the bust instead of the glute, which is the wrong dimorphic emphasis for this character. Absolute depths in the sheet are from a differently proportioned AI figure, so judge the ratios, not the absolutes.
